The attack occurred at a bridge crossing the Teltow Canal and caused a blackout affecting about 45,000 residents, as well as local businesses, hospitals, and nursing homes in southwestern Berlin. Stromnetz Berlin, the local utility company, has since restored power to approximately 7,000 residents, but others may face a longer wait for reconnection.
